title: Autoencoder-GAN Reconstruction & Hold
intuition: Jointly trains an encoder, learned particle prior, decoder/generator, and critic on a compact representation-holding task. It verifies that adversarial updates do not erode autoencoder reconstruction fidelity (recon_mse <= 0.05) or drift off the protected hold subspace (hold <= 0.35).
failure_mode: Naive adversarial gradients overwhelm the reconstruction objective, inflating recon_mse or causing the learned prior and decoder to drift away from the encoded data manifold.
protocol_notes: Locked-shared 250-step behavioral host with public-recipe scheduled output noise; encoder receives only the original reconstruction objective.
